scripts.//-- setup --: One-time bootstrap: install deps, start local Postgres (:5434), apply migrations, start Mailpit (:8026). See docs/run-locally.md.
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm dev:db:up && pnpm dev:db:migrate && pnpm dev:mail:up
scripts.//-- dev --: dev = frontend (:7777) + backend (:3001) in parallel. Needs dev:db:up first.
scripts.//-- db --: Local Postgres 17 in docker on :5434 (user/db water, app role water_app). Migrations live in backend/migrations.
scripts.dev:db:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm dev:db:up && pnpm dev:db:migrate
scripts.//-- mail --: Mailpit catches all local email (verify, password reset, invites): SMTP :1026, web UI http://localhost:8026. The backend's dev default is MAIL_TRANSPORT=smtp → Mailpit; see docs/run-locally.md § Email.
scripts.//-- data --: Demo data. seed:examples = 3 invented catchments + 2 demo users (demo@ / analyst@example.com, password demo-password), works on any clone. seed:demo = seed:examples + the client workbooks in ../project-water-management-source/Original/ (needs Python + openpyxl, scripts/wbt-import/README.md), its gauge column imported as a reference gauge (WBT_GAUGE_* in bin/seed-demo.sh). pan-sensitivity takes any project.json (no DB): GR4J at a few pan-coefficient choices, fixed vs refitted, written to a Markdown table (docs/model.md §2.4a; the client catchment's own report stays in the gitignored data/client-catchment/, never committed).
scripts.//-- gen --: Generated assets, committed. gen:help-art renders the help pictures (one Blender scene, several shots) with Blender 5 + ImageMagick 7 (optional tooling; scripts/help-art/catchment.py; HELP_ART_ONLY=shot,… for some).
scripts.//-- build --: Production builds: static frontend (frontend/build) and the Lambda bundle (backend/dist/lambda.mjs).
scripts.//-- check --: Typecheck every workspace, plus the repo guards CI runs: committed env files stay local (check:env), workflow pins/OIDC/gate rules + actionlint (check:workflows), frontend bundle ceilings (check:bundle, after build:frontend), advisory privacy-doc drift vs origin/main (check:compliance), no client-identifying term in any tracked file or path (check:terms; needs ../infra-secrets/water-management/client-terms.txt, else a no-op).
scripts.//-- test --: test = unit tests everywhere (no DB, no wall-clock assertions). test:guards = node:test suites for the CI/release guards in scripts/. test:backend:db needs dev:db:up; it migrates and uses the water_test database. test:engine:perf / test:backend:perf are separate performance-budget targets (median of several runs; not part of `test` because a busy machine or parallel workspaces would make a hard wall-clock ceiling flake — run them alone).
scripts.//-- e2e --: Playwright (Chromium), fully local. Needs dev:db:up; rebuilds its own database and starts its own backend + a production build of the frontend (frontend/build-e2e; dev servers and frontend/build untouched): water_e2e, :3101 and :7801 in the main checkout, a per-worktree slot elsewhere (E2E_SLOT overrides; e2e/support/env.ts), so two checkouts can run it at once. First time: test:e2e:install. See e2e/README.md.
scripts.//-- infra --: Terraform in infra/: credential-free fmt -check + validate + plan-only `terraform test` (mocked providers, tests/guardrails.tftest.hcl). Needs terraform (tfenv, infra/.terraform-version). Never plans against or applies to AWS; see infra/README.md.
